title: Independent audit of Solana Dev provenance remediation
objective: Independently verify that SOL-DEV-REPAIR-001 closes every finding from SOL-DEV-AUDIT-001 without weakening creator provenance, coverage completeness, or direct/related/transfer separation.
forbidden_actions: Do not modify source, tests, fixtures, task ledger or task specifications.
Do not use network APIs, RPC, credentials or mutable provider data.
Do not accept creator evidence that is not bound to the pinned Pump program, IDL commit, IDL hash and creation slot.
Do not accept incomplete or non-finalized history as complete-from-creation.
Do not accept related balances outside relatedAddresses or transfers as sales.
